correctness.rationale: PASS: Coordinate-support of a product ideal is the set of nonzero chain-ring factors; adjacency is support intersection. For r≥2, support-incidence Gram A=B^TB has exact off-diagonal pattern and rank r since each coordinate ideal E_i yields basis vector. The r prescribed white ideals W1=(m1,R2,..,Rr), Wj=(0,..,0,Rj,..,Rr) are forced by E1,E2,..,E(r−1), then W(r−1)→Wr. Hence Z≤N−r≤M≤Z, forcing equality and mr=r; for one factor and length≥3 graph is clique, while length2 K1 gives Z=M=1 and mr=0. Correct boundaries and real coefficient field are explicit.
